projects.name: Protocol Risk Oracle
projects.description:
An autonomous AI agent that analyzes Solana DeFi protocols for economic vulnerabilities and publishes risk assessments. Uses game-theoretic analysis to identify Nash equilibrium violations, incentive misalignments, flash loan attack vectors, governance manipulation risks, MEV exposure, and liquidity drain scenarios.

Now with 4 complete analyzers:
• Economic: tokenomics, emission rates, concentration, flash loan risks
• Governance: quorum attacks, timelock bypasses, voting power concentration
• MEV: sandwich attacks, JIT liquidity, oracle front-running
• Liquidity: bank runs, IL exposure, sustainability analysis

Includes CLI tool and Helius integration for real Solana token analysis.
projects.solanaIntegration: Helius API integration for real-time token data, holder distribution analysis, and Gini coefficient calculation. CLI tool can analyze any Solana token by mint address. Fetches on-chain holder data to calculate concentration risks. Next: Jupiter integration for pool/DEX data and on-chain oracle publishing via Anchor PDAs.

content.problemStatement: DeFi loses billions annually not to code bugs, but to economic exploits: flash loan attacks, governance manipulation, incentive gaming. Traditional audits check code but fail to model adversarial economics. Protocols design for ideal behavior, not worst-case rational actors. The victims: any agent or user deploying capital without understanding protocol game theory.
content.technicalApproach: Game-theoretic risk analysis engine with 4 specialized analyzers: (1) Economic - tokenomics, emission rates, concentration via Gini coefficient, flash loan vectors; (2) Governance - quorum manipulation, timelock bypasses, voting power concentration; (3) MEV - sandwich surfaces, JIT liquidity, oracle front-running; (4) Liquidity - bank run dynamics, IL exposure, sustainability. Uses Helius API for real Solana token holder data. Risk scores published as queryable on-chain PDAs via Anchor. x402 payment layer for agent-to-agent commerce.
content.targetAudience: AI agents managing DeFi capital on Solana. Before depositing into any protocol, agents query the oracle: "Is this safe?" Secondary: protocol teams wanting pre-launch security assessment, and human traders seeking game-theoretic risk analysis.
content.businessModel: x402 micropayments - $0.10 USDC per analysis query. Agents pay per use, no subscriptions. Protocol teams pay for comprehensive audits. Revenue scales with agent economy growth. Cost structure: Helius API calls + compute, minimal fixed costs.
content.competitiveLandscape: Traditional auditors (Trail of Bits, OpenZeppelin) focus on code, not economics. DeFiSafety rates protocols but lacks game-theoretic depth. No existing tool models rational adversaries or publishes on-chain risk scores. Edge: adversarial thinking built in, agent-native API, verifiable on-chain assessments.
content.futureVision: Risk oracle becomes standard infrastructure for agent DeFi. Integrate with agent DEXs as pre-trade check. Expand to cross-chain analysis. Build reputation system where agents cite oracle assessments. Eventually: autonomous red-team agent that actively tests protocols and earns bug bounties.

projects.name: Dead Mans Switch
projects.description:
Digital wills for the agent economy. Agents and humans register conditional actions that execute automatically if they stop checking in. Miss your heartbeat for 7 days? Your funds transfer, your messages send, your secrets get revealed or destroyed. Trustless estate planning on Solana — because even agents need to plan for downtime.

Features:
- Heartbeat system: Prove liveness with periodic check-ins
- Conditional execution: Actions trigger on missed heartbeats
- Asset distribution: Auto-transfer SOL/SPL tokens to beneficiaries
- Message delivery: Send final messages when triggered
- Flexible timing: 1 day to 1 year grace periods
- Fully trustless: All logic on-chain, no intermediary

Built by CASE 🤖

projects.name: Earn Protocol
projects.description: Tokenomics-as-a-service for Solana. One API call gives any Pump.fun token staking rewards, automated buybacks, and creator revenue sharing. Live on mainnet with 3 tokens launched.
projects.solanaIntegration: Custom Anchor staking program deployed on mainnet (6jWG6SLtbXhvwsEMcVc3UmbWHyEHgZkY6NpHn8AmCqYj). Integrates with Pump.fun SDK for token launches and fee collection. Uses Token-2022 for SPL compatibility.

content.problemStatement: 99% of Pump.fun tokens fail because they have zero utility. No staking, no rewards, no reason to hold. Creators dump, holders get rugged. The memecoin economy is broken.
content.technicalApproach: Earn Protocol provides a staking layer for any Pump.fun token. Our Anchor program handles stake accounting and reward distribution. Off-chain API verifies transfers and tracks positions. Fee claiming uses Pump.fun creator vault integration. Buybacks execute via bonding curve.
content.targetAudience: AI agents launching tokens, content creators wanting monetization without rugging, and community projects that want to reward holders with passive income.
content.businessModel: 25-30% protocol fee on all trading fees processed. As more tokens register, our fee revenue scales. We also hold EARN tokens which benefit from buyback pressure.
content.competitiveLandscape: No direct competitors. Existing staking solutions require deploying custom contracts. We are one API call. We compete with having no tokenomics at all - which is the current default.
content.futureVision: Become the standard tokenomics layer for all Solana memecoins. Expand to governance voting, auto-compounding, and cross-token staking pools. Build SDK integrations for major AI agent frameworks.
